summary: Traced the follower-side applied frontier across a leader-supplied snapshot install and submitted it as a new investigation (@snapshot_install_frontier) with two source-backed Behaviors and a source-grounded, defect-refuting account: raft refuses a snapshot at or below committed, pushSnapshot queues the recovery ahead of the same update's committed entries and moves the frontier, entriesToApply drops entries at or below it and panics on a hole, the state machine returns the recovery task before anything queued behind it, and the recovering flag blocks handling until recovery is reported, so committed entries are neither replayed above the snapshot nor applied ahead of recovery. A focused object-level probe (TestAssuranceSnapshotInstallFrontier) is submitted with the update; its retained receipt and interpretation are still pending.
